title: Holding Several Program Enrollments — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
A patient may hold several enrollments in the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs at the same time, because manufacturer and foundation programs are each tied to one drug.

## The rule

1. **Several enrollments are allowed.** One patient's profile may carry enrollments of different program types, and enrollments of the same program type for different drugs.
2. **Per-drug ceiling.** Open enrollments of the same program type for the same drug never exceed that program type's maximum number of open enrollments per drug. An enrollment counts as open while it is pending activation, active or suspended; an expired or cancelled enrollment does not count.
3. **No overall ceiling per patient.** No maximum is set on the total number of enrollments one patient holds across program types and drugs.
4. **Combining on a fill is a separate question.** Holding several enrollments does not decide how they combine on one fill; that is decided by the rule that exactly one program is applied to any one fill.

## Points of judgement

| Situation on the profile | Counts toward the per-drug ceiling? |
|---|---|
| Enrollment of the same program type, same drug, pending activation | Yes |
| Same program type, same drug, suspended | Yes |
| Same program type, same drug, expired or cancelled | No |
| Same program type, a different drug | No (a different drug has its own ceiling) |
| A different program type, same drug | No (each program type has its own ceiling) |

*Hypothetical example:* a patient holds an active Manufacturer Copay Card for one drug and an active Charitable Foundation Copay Grant for the same drug. The two are different program types, so neither enrollment counts toward the other's ceiling.
